title: Sneakers & Resale Collecting Weekend vs Weekday Split
dataSources: StockX market prices (`stockx:price`), GOAT listings (`goat:listing`), Alias sales (`alias:sale`), sneaker rotation logs (`sneaker:rotation`), and deadstock age checks (`deadstock:age`).
app: StockX price alerts, GOAT listing exports, Alias seller settlement logs, sneaker rotation wear trackers, and deadstock age audits ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=deadstock:age
| eval day_type=if(in(strftime(_time,"%u"),"6","7"),"weekend","weekday")
| stats count as events, avg(duration_min) as avg_duration by day_type
description: Separates sneakers activity between weekdays and weekends when duration is present.
value: Weekend/weekday splits quickly show whether a life domain is work-driven, leisure-driven, or bleeding into the wrong days.
implementation: Populate optional `duration_min` on `deadstock:age` events if available; the search still works on counts alone when duration is missing.
visualization: Side-by-side bar chart of weekday vs weekend event counts.
grandmaExplanation: It works out whether your sneakers activity mostly happens on weekdays or weekends so you can see if the habit fits the life you actually live.
